search_window.basis: Since most recent verified Care Line Watch heartbeat, plus bounded recall. Provider-announced Winslow reopening crossed effective time during this window; actual on-site operation not independently verified. Production collector remains authoritative.

findings.title: Winslow Indian Health Care Center announces same-day soft reopening of walk-in care and prescription refills after flooding disruption
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Winslow Campus will begin a soft opening of walk-in services for patients at 1:00 PM today. Pharmacy services for prescription refills will also be available.
findings.access_consequences: Provider announced that walk-in patient visits would partially resume at 1 p.m. Arizona MST on November 3, along with prescription refill pharmacy access; this followed flooding-related suspension of most services. Not a full campus reopening. Scheduled effective time had passed at observation; post-opening patient operations not independently verified.
findings.affected_population: Winslow campus walk-in patients and prescription refill patients, including Navajo Nation chapter communities served by WIHCC

coverage_notes.quality_limitations: Bounded supplementary recall, not exhaustive national or territorial collection. Search relevance poor for territorial, air-medical, dialysis, oncology and rural closures. WIHCC reopening is time-effective according to provider notice, but no later provider bulletin or eyewitness confirmation of actually reopened walk-in services found. Existing Health First official endpoint inaccessible; DEGRADED despite useful coverage.
coverage_notes.controls: Private handoff only; pending editorial review; no approval, publication, schedule alteration, task disabling or production collector mutation.
